body: Use case: stylized-concept. Production eight-direction BODY-ONLY sprite sheet for Last on Grid, grounded detailed hand-painted 2994 abandoned-world racing game. Original fictional Copperwing 2004 compact two-seat front-engine fastback coupe, inspired only by early2000s long-hood short-tail sporting packaging, NOT a replica. Muted copper paint, dark plum roof and rear quarter repair panel, cream lower sill repair. Sculpted long bonnet, distinctive revised paired rectangular inset headlights and separated short horizontal rear lamps, compact rounded fastback roof, no real grille or badges. Exact3:1 canvas,4columns2rows equal8cells: top FRONT, FRONT-RIGHT nose LEFT, RIGHT SIDE nose LEFT, REAR-RIGHT rear RIGHT; bottom REAR, REAR-LEFT rear LEFT, LEFT SIDE nose RIGHT, FRONT-LEFT nose RIGHT. Consistent same car and scale, whole body centered with margins in eachcell. All wheel arches are EMPTY TRANSPARENT HOLES through the car, no wheels, tires, hubs or dark wheelwell backing anywhere. Truly transparent background and wheelholes, no ground shadows or scenery. Subtle scrapes rust and repairs but drivable. Diffuse consistent light, detailed clean readable game artwork. No logos or text.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Production original fictional Copperwing 2004 cockpit foreground PNG for Last on Grid 2994 salvage racing. Compact two-seat front-engine fastback coupe, LEFT HAND DRIVE. Muted copper body, plum and cream repaired trim. Grounded detailed hand-painted weathered dark charcoal low sports dashboard, aged brushed-metal center console and short manual gearlever. Very wide2.5:1 driver-eye first-person view. Windshield fully transparent, no sky/scenery; continuous dashboard lowerhalf to bottomedge. Large EMPTY BLACK recessed instrument binnacle on LEFT centered at26%width,64%height, wide enough for runtime speed RPM gear numerals. Shared runtime steeringwheel will be centered at26%width83%height so keep binnacle face high and unobstructed. No drawn steeringwheel, no gauges/numerals/needles/hands, no logos/text. Small center vents, worn copper stitching and repaired plum passenger trim, restrained salvage scratches not wrecked. Diffuse consistent light, detailed clean readable game art.
